'''Kidd Kareen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CC" />

==Biography==
Inspired by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who had won the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] at the age of nine, Kidd Kareen's parents began training their son as a podracer before he could even walk. He traveled with the podracing circuit around the galaxy, and formed an unbeatable racing team with [[San Maxus]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he met [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] who was undercover at the time as a fellow podracer, while trying to find a Separatist agent who had possessed a top secret Republic [[Datafile/Legends|data file]]. After one of his races he met with her and the two realized they had a mutual attraction to each other. Lending her a podracer for the big race, he kissed Ahsoka on the cheek for luck before leaving to go to his team.<ref name="CC" />

Maxus, after consulting with [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], revealed himself to be a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] agent and showed Kareen who Ahsoka really was: a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. During the final race on [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]], Kareen was forced to decide whether to help Ahsoka or remain loyal to Maxus, who was intent on killing her. He chose to assist Ahsoka when Maxus destroyed her podracer, and together they caught up to Maxus. Upon arriving, Ahsoka and Kareen found themselves facing [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], who had come to meet Maxus in order to retrieve the Republic data file he had stolen. However, before Maxus could hand off the Republic datafile, Anakin destroyed the file by [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force crushing]] it.<ref name="CC" />

Afterwards, Kareen and Ahsoka parted ways. Kareen offered Ahsoka a chance to be on his team, but she had to turn him down due to her obligations to the Jedi Order. After Ahsoka said her master's last name, Kareen realized who Anakin was, and challenged him to a friendly race someday when the war was over. Anakin went back into the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], and before Ahsoka left he kissed her hand.<ref name="CC" />

==Personality and traits==
Kareen had blue skin with teal-colored spots on his [[Lekku/Legends|Lekku]].<ref name="CC" />
